_comment: Browser matbot config (the matbot.yaml analogue, as JSON so the node assembler needs no YAML parser). Plugin entries are repo-relative package paths; the assembler resolves them to inlined modules (preferring each package's `browser` export condition). `plugins` is the AUTO-LOAD core (loaded at boot) — kept minimal, mirroring node where only configured plugins load. `bundledPlugins` are baked into the artifact and the import map but NOT auto-loaded: they're offered via the browser `plugin` tool's discover and loaded on demand by package name, which (being baked) persists across reloads with no network. `providers` is intentionally empty — the browser asks for the full provider config at first startup and persists it. `providerModules` are the adapters the wizard offers. `assets` are raw files baked verbatim for the in-process frontend to inject. This is the default, full-featured UI (frontend/web's browser entry, sharing index.html + app.js with the Node server); the minimal demonstrator is matbot.web-demo.json.
